hypotheses_ranked.name: Trough-gated hydrothermal magnetite-destruction and vent-alignment corridors (THIS SESSION)
hypotheses_ranked.non_fault_mimic: Reversed-polarity volcanic flows / felsic tuffs (primary susceptibility lows); saline playa pans (cond high, dilatation ~0, suppressed by the product gate); E-W GeoDAWN tie-line troughs (suppressed by acquisition-block cross-check + strike-diversity requirement).
hypotheses_ranked.novelty_vs_fleet: H73-MVH uses vent logdists + Radon16 occupancy + ventxcondxK witness + tilt/worms/shallow-residual magnetics (verified in src/gems73/mvh_features.py 2026-10-24; NO valley-curvature trough operator, NO dilatation coupling, NO pairwise inter-vent segments, and it uses catalogue-derived relay-bridge mechanics). H85-HJCD uses 2m-T + sinter + chi + GEO-Pb-16 + ray integrals (no troughs, no condxdilatation). Empirical overlap vs both rasters is measured; >0.70 = duplicate-stop.
hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: (1) Signed magnetic valley-curvature: Hessian eigendecomposition of sigma=1.5px-smoothed RTP and tmi_vg; trough-ness = positive larger-eigenvalue lobe with cross-strike anisotropy, max over the two bands. (2) Clay-cap dilatation concordance: positive-part z-score product z(cond_surf)+ x z(geod_dilaterate)+, sigma=2px. (3) Pairwise vent corridors: Bresenham segments between hot-vent points 1-6 km apart, retained only if a third vent continues the alignment within a 2px strip over 120px (collinear triple; amendment A1: 8 strikes tile the circle so chaining carries the co-linear constraint), segment-density smoothed sigma=1.5px, reported raw AND gated by (trough > footprint median AND concordance > footprint median).
hypotheses_ranked.why_unmapped: Blind geothermal fault conduits under alluvial/clay cover lose their surface scarp (det_elev_slope muted) while hydrothermal magnetite destruction keeps a linear magnetic trough, smectite-illite clay keeps cond_surf high inside dilating crust, and sinters/springs/2m anomalies align along the feeder even where no Holocene scarp was mapped. Tested by enrichment on withheld whole components, NOT assumed.

lane_paragraph: H86F-HMDC (strictly zero-catalogue hydrothermal fault discovery).
